title: 2051. Binary Search - Find an Element
description:

Problem Statement
Given a sorted array of integers and a target value, find the position of the target using binary search.
Description
Read an array sorted in ascending order and a target value. Use binary search by repeatedly checking the middle element and reducing the search range. Print the 0-based index if the target is found; otherwise print -1.
Input Description
The first line contains an integer n. The second line contains n space-separated integers in ascending order. The third line contains an integer target.
Output Description
Print the 0-based index of target if it is found; otherwise print -1.
Sample Input
6
3 8 12 17 21 25
17
Sample Output
3
